description: Microsoft Agent Framework .NET 1.28.0 over OpenAI 2.14.0: one agent run with one tool round, traced by UseOpenTelemetry with EnableSensitiveData on, so content lands in span attributes.
notes: Agent Framework puts the agent's instance id in the invoke_agent span name, masked by volatile_name_prefixes, and in gen_ai.agent.id, masked by volatile_attributes.
